q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of plastic caps and closures?
title: Plastic closure carbon footprint per kg
short: Caps are mostly polymer: multiply the PP or HDPE used per kg of caps by the resin supplier's figure, add liners and masterbatch, then add moulding or compression moulding energy per kg of good caps.

p: Report per kg, or per thousand caps by weight. Lighter caps cut the resin figure directly.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 49,700 / 80,000 = 0.621 kg CO2 per kg
Add resin and masterbatch for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
